name: Creating a user with an existing email is rejected
description:
Objective: Creating a user with an existing email is rejected.
Preconditions: Open User Management with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User Management.
2. Creating a user with an existing email is rejected.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
descriptionHtml:

statusMessage: AssertionError: Duplicate-email validation was not rendered (no POST response (client-side validation path)). No visible duplicate-email validation message appeared within 45000 ms.
statusTrace:
pages/user_management_page.py:1284: in attempt_create_duplicate_email_user
    self.assert_duplicate_email_validation_visible()
pages/user_management_page.py:2364: in assert_duplicate_email_validation_visible
    wait_for_first_visible(
pages/playwright_helpers.py:153: in wait_for_first_visible
    raise AssertionError(f"No visible {description} appeared within {timeout} ms.")
E   AssertionError: No visible duplicate-email validation message appeared within 45000 ms.

The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception:
tests/e2e/admin/test_user_management.py:600: in test_creating_user_with_existing_email_is_rejected
    user_management_page.attempt_create_duplicate_email_user(

    raise AssertionError(
